name: Eugenio Siena
features: dark slicked-back hair, lean weathered face, focused deep-set eyes, wiry mechanic's build, dark overalls
bio: A Milanese mechanic and cousin of Giuseppe Campari who rose through Alfa Romeo's workshop as Enzo Ferrari's assistant before proving just as capable behind the wheel. He raced for Scuderia Ferrari from 1930 to 1934, winning the 1932 Spa 24 Hours sharing an 8C with Antonio Brivio and partnering Tazio Nuvolari in the 1934 Mille Miglia, then ran his own Scuderia Siena on Maseratis. Alfa Romeo finally called him back with a works seat at the end of 1937.
